MATCH (m:Model {model_code: 'ER5-120WAL59-0059'})
MATCH (so:SalesOrder)-[:HAS_LINE]->(li:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WHERE so.status = 'completed' AND date_part('year', so.order_date) = 2025
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[:MAPS_TO {qty: map_qty}]->(m)
WITH so, li, sku, map_qty
OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle:SKU {is_bundle: true})-[:BUNDLES {qty: bundle_qty}]->(sku)
OPTIONAL MATCH (bundle)-[:BUNDLES {qty: bundle_qty2}]->(sku2:SKU)-[:MAPS_TO {qty: map_qty2}]->(m)
WITH so, li, sku, 
     CASE 
       WHEN map_qty IS NOT NULL THEN map_qty
       WHEN bundle_qty2 IS NOT NULL THEN bundle_qty * bundle_qty2 * map_qty2
       ELSE 0
     END AS model_qty_per_sku
RETURN SUM(li.qty * model_qty_per_sku) AS total_units
